text.p: Here are the leading headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio stations's noon news report on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- European Affairs Minister Laima Andrikiene said at a news conference that the privatisation of Lithuanian Tellecomm might begin at the start of next year.
- The Social Democratic Party says it will organise a referendum on the issue of privatising strategic enterprises, which it strongly opposes.
- Parliamentary chairman Vytautas Landsbergis is in Germany, where he will meet with the president of the Bundestag, Rita Ziusmut.
- Lithuania and Belarus continue to negotiate agreements on investment protection and promotion.
